## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? One or two sentences.

## Proposed solution

Describe the shape of the feature. Mockups, examples, or command-line sketches
are very welcome.

## Alternatives considered

What else have you considered, and why isn't it enough?

## Impact

Who benefits and how often?

- [ ] Almost everyone using the project
- [ ] A common use case
- [ ] An edge case for advanced users
- [ ] Just me / my team

## Anything else?

Related issues, links, prior art, screenshots.
